title: Visited Positions on a Prefix
statement: Let $M$ be a nondeterministic Turing machine with $k$ work tapes, let $w$ be a finite binary word, let $c$ be a configuration on a fixed input, let $j$ be a nonnegative integer, and choose a work tape $i$. Every head position visited on tape $i$ during the run under the prefix of $w$ of length $j$ is also visited during the run under $w$.
hypotheses_covered: A nondeterministic machine with $k$ work tapes and Boolean symbols and states in $S$
A configuration $c$ on a fixed Boolean input
